purpose: Predeclare one source-independent teacher recipe for the matched M versus O post-training-source comparison.
claim_boundary: This plan matches controlled post-training compute. With generation_batch_size equal to num_generations, 100 optimizer steps expose about 100 prompt groups sampled from the registered matched pool, not every pool row. It does not establish equal token counts, equal source difficulty, training-seed robustness, or complete historical pretraining exposure.
